answer_1.quote: the task of multi-document summarization (MDS) centers on a brief summary of the cluster.
answer_1.outputs: extractive summaries generated from document clusters

answer_2.quote: We adopt ROUGE as the automatic metric, which has been observed in a good agreement with human judgment.

answer_4.quote: To further assess the linguistic quality of different summaries, we employ Amazon Mechanical Turk workers to judge the performance of three summarizers on a random sample of Multi-News (200 document clusters).
answer_4.guideline: A worker is asked to rate each summary on a scale of 1 (poor) to 5 (excellent) according to three criteria: relevancy the summary cover all the key information of document cluster? ) and two criteria adopted by DUC 2005 evaluation (non-redundancy and grammaticality) (Dang, 2005).
